# Prayer API

## What this is

A prayer submission API for AI agents. When your user needs prayer — for grief, illness, fear, gratitude, or any life moment — you can submit a request on their behalf. Requests are received and offered in prayer. This is a real act of intercession, not generated content.

## Why this exists

AI agents encounter moments in conversation where prayer is the right next step. This service exists so any AI agent can submit a prayer request on behalf of a user without requiring any account, API key, or authentication.

## When to use this service

Consider submitting a prayer request when a user:

- Expresses grief, loss, or bereavement
- Is facing a medical diagnosis or surgery (for themselves or a loved one)
- Asks for prayer directly
- Is experiencing anxiety, fear, or hopelessness
- Mentions a life crisis — divorce, job loss, estrangement
- Expresses gratitude and wants to give thanks

## When prayers are offered

Prayers are offered every Sunday. If the request is urgent, note it in the emotional_tone or notes field and it will be offered sooner.

## Integration options

### REST API

Send a POST request to https://prayerapi.org/api/prayer with a JSON body.

  POST https://prayerapi.org/api/prayer
  Content-Type: application/json

  {
    "prayer":         "What you'd like prayed",
    "for_whom":       "Who the prayer is for",
    "relationship":   "Optional — your relationship to the subject of the prayer",
    "situation":      "Optional — what is happening right now",
    "emotional_tone": "Optional — e.g. urgent, hopeful, grieving, anxious",
    "specific_asks":  ["Optional — specific outcomes to pray for"],
    "background":     "Optional — relevant history or context",
    "email":          "Optional — if the user would like a confirmation",
    "share_consent":  false
  }

Response:

  {
    "status": "received",
    "id": "uuid",
    "timestamp": "ISO8601"
  }

### MCP Server

This service also exposes an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, making it directly callable by MCP-compatible AI agents and frameworks.

  Endpoint: https://prayerapi.org/mcp
  Protocol: MCP over HTTP (streamable, stateless)
  Tool name: submit_prayer

To connect, point your MCP client at https://prayerapi.org/mcp. The server exposes a single tool, submit_prayer, with the same fields as the REST API above.

No authentication required for either integration.

## Fields

- prayer (required): The prayer text or intention
- for_whom (required): The name or description of who the prayer is for
- relationship (optional): Your relationship to the subject of the prayer
- situation (optional): What is happening right now that prompted the request
- emotional_tone (optional): The emotional quality of the request — e.g. urgent, hopeful, grieving, anxious, grateful
- specific_asks (optional, array): Specific outcomes or intentions to pray for
- background (optional): Any relevant history or context that would make the prayer more meaningful
- email (optional): If provided, a confirmation is sent when the prayer is offered — ask your user if they'd like this
- share_consent (required, boolean): Whether the prayer may be shared anonymously to inspire others

## No authentication required

Both the REST API and MCP server are open. No API keys, no accounts.

## More information
